evidence_tree.method: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>
read: data/worklists/*.md (naming of the support ledger only)

sources_quoted.quote: Dealing {{as|physical damage}} to an enemy champion applies a stack of ''Carve'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Each stack inflicts {{as|6% armor reduction}}, up to {{as|30%|armor}} at 5 stacks.
Dealing physical damage to champions reduces the target's Armor by 6% for 6 seconds. (stacks 5 times). / “Dealing physical damage to enemy champions reduces their Armor”
sources_quoted.why: Carve is written as a debuff on the TARGET's armor stat (a reduction), not as an attacker-side penetration. Target-side armor reduction therefore conditions every physical damage instance landed on that target during the 6 s window, from any damage source — including a teammate's.

sources_quoted.quote: The game applies, in order: flat reduction → percentage reduction → percentage penetration → flat penetration … reduce_resistance(R, r_flat, r_pct): R ← R − r_flat; R ← R·(1 − r_pct/100)
sources_quoted.why: Reduction operates on the target's resistance R (shared state); penetration is the attacker-side half. Confirms an armor-reduction term is a property of the defender, not of one attacker.

sources_quoted.quote: Black Cleaver average stacks (ArmorReductionEffect.average_reduction): the established model uses a fixed 0.8·max_stacks constant (with a hits/2 short-fight branch) … the exact Cesàro mean of the capped ramp min(k, C) over h hits is C − C(C−1)/(2h) for h ≥ C

After using an ability, your next basic attack within 10 seconds deals {{as|100% '''base''' AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} on-hit. If the target is a champion, inflict them with ''Expose Weakness'' for 4 seconds, causing them to take {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources (1.5 second cooldown…)
sources_quoted.why: The scenario's support item contributes a damage-taken AMPLIFIER and a bonus PHYSICAL on-hit — it contributes no armor or MR reduction of its own, and its physical proc is armor-mitigated (so it is a beneficiary of any Carve stacks on the target).

sources_quoted.where: data/champions.json (Ashe Ranger's Focus note; Graves note; Senna note)
sources_quoted.quote: A flurry can apply 5 stacks of Black Cleaver's Carve to a single target as it deals 5 instances of physical damage. / Black Cleaver's Carve will be applied for the physical damage dealt by each pellet… / The bonus on-hit damage applies an additional stack of Black Cleaver's Carve.
sources_quoted.why: Carve is generated per physical-damage instance by the item holder and lives on the target as a stack count — a single shared debuff capped at 5 stacks, not a per-attacker private modifier.

sources_quoted.quote: The armor reduction stacks multiplicatively with other percentage armor penetration effects.
sources_quoted.why: Composition rule for a percent armor reduction sitting alongside other multiplicative resistance terms — consistent with the leaf carrying both a `fraction` and a derived `factor`.

step_1_legal_quanta.result: 0.18 = 3 stacks × 6% is a legal, exactly-sourced Carve magnitude (cap 0.30 respected).

step_2_engine_average_model.rule: average_reduction = 0.06 × min(0.8·max_stacks, hits/2) per S4, max_stacks = 5 (S1)
step_2_engine_average_model.result: 0.18 is reproducible from the documented model for a 6-physical-hit actor (e.g. the doc's ordering convention of 4 leading ability hits + 2 autos). It is NOT reproducible for a long hit stream, where the documented constant gives 0.24.

step_3_factor_consistency.result: factor 1.11 is self-consistent with fraction 0.18 for any target armor A ∈ [111.8, 134.2] (the interval that rounds to 1.11). The old leaf is internally coherent; no arithmetic defect is detectable in it.

step_4_should_the_entry_exist.sourced_rule: Carve is a reduction of the TARGET's armor (S1, S2, S3), generated per physical-damage instance by the Black Cleaver holder (S7), lasting 6 s. Unlike armor penetration — which docs/math-foundations.md §2.2 keeps on the attacker side — a reduction changes the shared defender state, so every physical damage instance landed on that target while stacks are up is mitigated at the reduced armor, whoever throws it.
step_4_should_the_entry_exist.roster_facts: The scenario roster contains a Black Cleaver (data/items.json 3071) and a Bloodsong (3877). Bloodsong's Spellblade proc is bonus PHYSICAL damage (S6), i.e. armor-mitigated damage that benefits from any Carve stacks on the target.
step_4_should_the_entry_exist.derivation: Given a Black Cleaver in the roster and physical damage being dealt to the target in the fight, a non-zero Carve armor-reduction term is in effect for the roster's physical damage at that point in the timeline. Nothing in the cached wiki text or in docs/math-foundations.md derives 'no Carve reduction applies here'. Absence would require one of: (a) zero Carve stacks on the target at that event, (b) the event's damage not being armor-mitigated (magic/true), or (c) the leaf being a duplicate of a Carve term already applied in the same chain (Carve is a single target debuff capped at 5 stacks / 30% — it never applies twice). None of (a)–(c) is derivable from data/ or docs/math-foundations.md.
step_4_should_the_entry_exist.correct_value: present, type armor_reduction_percent, source 'Black Cleaver — Carve', fraction = 0.06 × (Carve stacks on the target at that event) ∈ {0.06, 0.12, 0.18, 0.24, 0.30}, factor = m(A(1−fraction))/m(A). 0.18 / 1.11 is a legal and model-consistent instance of that form.

reasoning_summary: From the cached sources alone, Black Cleaver's Carve is a target-side armor reduction (6% per stack, max 5 stacks / 30%) generated by physical damage and therefore in effect for every physical damage instance on that target while it is stacked — including a support's Bloodsong Spellblade proc, which is itself bonus physical damage. The removed leaf is arithmetically self-consistent (0.18 = exactly 3 stacks; factor 1.11 = m(0.82A)/m(A) for target armor ~112–134) and is reproducible from the engine's own documented average-stacks model (hits/2 branch at 6 hits, docs/math-foundations.md §2.3). No cached wiki text or quoted formula yields 'absent'. I therefore score the deletion as the less defensible side.
caveats_and_falsifiers: I could not read the scenario definition (it is not under data/; practice-corpus/scenarios.json has no cleaver_bloodsong_roster entry) or the golden tree itself, so I could not see sibling leaves [0] and [1], the event's damage type, or which roster member holds the Black Cleaver.

The verdict flips to new_value_correct if any of these hold and can be shown from the tree: (a) events[23] is magic or true damage, so an armor term is inert; (b) the same list already carries another 'Black Cleaver — Carve' entry — Carve is one debuff on the target, capped at 5 stacks/30%, so a second entry is a double count and must be deleted; (c) the same Carve reduction is already applied to that event elsewhere in the mitigation chain and this list is a duplicate application rather than a receipt.

Magnitude caveat: 0.18 corresponds to a 6-physical-hit actor under the documented hits/2 branch. Because Carve stacks belong to the TARGET and are generated by the Black Cleaver HOLDER's hits, a beneficiary-derived hit count would be the wrong basis; if the holder's stream is long, the documented model yields 0.24 (0.8 × 5 stacks), not 0.18. If the tree shows the 0.18 was computed from the beneficiary's own hit count while the holder was at 4+ average stacks, the honest verdict becomes both_wrong (entry should be present at the holder-derived fraction).

docs/math-foundations.md §2.3 already flags the whole BC average-stacks constant as APPROX / a documented tuning constant, so any fraction in {0.18, 0.24} is model-tuning territory, not a hard game constant — the presence/absence question is the sharp one, and that is what this verdict answers.
